# Diavolo archive format 0.1 (UNSTABLE)

> **UNSTABLE.** Archives in this format may become unreadable by later builds. Readers refuse every version not listed under *Acceptance*.

Spec schema 1. Integers are little-endian. Offsets are from byte 0 of the archive file unless stated. Reasons for these decisions: `docs/design/0001-archive-layout.md`.

## Acceptance

| file major | file minor | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | accept |
| *any other* | | reject |

## Physical layout

```
offset 0                 header        (header.LEN bytes)
                         block*        (block_header + payload, tiling)
trailer.index_offset     INDX block    (block_header + index payload)
EOF - trailer.LEN        trailer
```

## Constants

| name | value | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `MAX_CHUNK_RAW` | 1048576 | Largest raw (uncompressed) length of one extent / DATA block, bytes. |
| `NSEC_LIMIT` | 1000000000 | Every *_nsec field MUST be strictly less than this. |
| `NAME_MAX` | 255 | Longest dirent name, bytes. |
| `XATTR_NAME_MAX` | 255 | Longest xattr name, bytes. |
| `XATTR_VALUE_MAX` | 65536 | Longest xattr value, bytes. |
| `SYMLINK_MAX` | 4095 | Longest symlink target, bytes. |
| `HEADER_MAGIC` | `89 44 56 4C 0D 0A 1A 0A` | \x89 D V L \r \n \x1a \n |
| `TRAILER_MAGIC` | `89 44 56 54 0D 0A 1A 0A` | \x89 D V T \r \n \x1a \n |

## Enumerations

Value 0 is `invalid` in every enumeration. Values not listed, and registered-but-undefined values, are rejected.

### `codec` (u16)

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x0001 | `stored` | Payload bytes are the raw bytes. |
| 0x0002 | `zstd` | Payload bytes are one RFC 8878 zstd frame decoding to the raw bytes. |

### `index_codec` (u16)

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x0001 | `stored` | Index tables follow the index header uncompressed. |

### `source_fs` (u16)

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x0001 | `ext4` | Linux ext2/3/4, read via libext2fs. fs_flags are ext4 i_flags. |

### `content_kind` (u16)

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x0001 | `none` | Type has no content: directory, device, FIFO, socket. |
| 0x0002 | `extents` | Regular file whose content is the extents in THIS archive; uncovered bytes are zero. |
| 0x0003 | `inherited` | Regular file whose content is that of the same ino in chain entry chain_ref. |
| 0x0004 | `symlink` | Symbolic link; target is heap bytes [target_off, target_off + size). |
| 0x0005 | `excluded` | Regular file deliberately not captured. NOT a deletion. Metadata is valid; content is absent. |

### `completeness` (u16)

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x0001 | `complete` | The directory's dirent range is its entire entry list at capture time. |
| 0x0002 | `partial` *(registered, undefined)* | Reserved for a partial list plus tombstones. MUST NOT be written in 0.x; a reader rejects it. |

### `file_type` (u32)

Compared after masking with `0xF000`.

| value | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0x0000 | `invalid` | Never valid. |
| 0x1000 | `fifo` | S_IFIFO |
| 0x2000 | `chr` | S_IFCHR |
| 0x4000 | `dir` | S_IFDIR |
| 0x6000 | `blk` | S_IFBLK |
| 0x8000 | `reg` | S_IFREG |
| 0xA000 | `lnk` | S_IFLNK |
| 0xC000 | `sock` | S_IFSOCK |

### content_kind admitted per file_type

| file_type | content_kind |
|---|---|
| `blk` | `none` |
| `chr` | `none` |
| `dir` | `none` |
| `fifo` | `none` |
| `lnk` | `symlink` |
| `reg` | `extents`, `inherited`, `excluded` |
| `sock` | `none` |

## Flag sets

Every flag set follows the even/odd convention: an unknown bit at an even position is ignored; an unknown bit at an odd position rejects the file.

### `header_flags` (u32; unknown odd bit: `header.flags_unknown_odd`)

No bits defined.

### `trailer_flags` (u32; unknown odd bit: `trailer.flags_unknown_odd`)

No bits defined.

### `block_flags` (u32; unknown odd bit: `block.flags_unknown_odd`)

| bit | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `skip` | Optional block: a reader that does not know type_id ignores it. MUST NOT be set on DATA or INDX. |

### `capabilities` (u32; unknown odd bit: `index.capabilities_unknown_odd`)

| bit | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `xattrs` | Writer read extended attributes of every inode. |
| 1 | `fs_flags` | Writer recorded fs_flags of every inode. |
| 2 | `crtime` | Writer recorded crtime of every inode whose source has one. |

### `present` (u32; unknown odd bit: `inode.present_unknown_odd`)

| bit | name | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `nsec` | The four *_nsec fields are recorded. If clear they MUST be 0 and mean 'not recorded', not 'zero'. |
| 1 | `crtime` | crtime_sec/crtime_nsec are recorded. If clear they MUST be 0. |

## Block types

| id | status | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DATA` | defined | One chunk of one regular file's content. |
| `INDX` | defined | The index. Exactly one, immediately before the trailer. |
| `CRYP` | registered_undefined | Encrypted segment. MUST NOT be written until defined. |
| `KDFP` | registered_undefined | Key-derivation parameters. MUST NOT be written until defined. |
| `PAR2` | registered_undefined | Recovery data. MUST NOT be written until defined. |
| `PACK` | registered_undefined | Several files' chunks in one block. MUST NOT be written until defined. |

## Layouts

### `header` — 32 bytes

At offset 0. Written first, never rewritten.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `magic` | bytes8 |  | HEADER_MAGIC. |
| 8 | 2 | `format_major` | u16 |  | See acceptance. |
| 10 | 2 | `format_minor` | u16 |  | See acceptance. |
| 12 | 4 | `header_flags` | u32 | flags `header_flags` |  |
| 16 | 16 | `archive_uuid` | bytes16 |  | Random (v4) UUID naming this archive. |

### `trailer` — 160 bytes

The last 160 bytes of the file. The root of trust.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `magic` | bytes8 |  | TRAILER_MAGIC. |
| 8 | 2 | `format_major` | u16 |  | == header.format_major. |
| 10 | 2 | `format_minor` | u16 |  | == header.format_minor. |
| 12 | 4 | `trailer_flags` | u32 | flags `trailer_flags` |  |
| 16 | 16 | `archive_uuid` | bytes16 |  | == header.archive_uuid. |
| 32 | 8 | `archive_len` | u64 |  | Byte length of the complete archive file, trailer included. |
| 40 | 8 | `index_offset` | u64 |  | Offset in the complete archive of the INDX block header. |
| 48 | 8 | `index_len` | u64 |  | Payload length of the INDX block. |
| 56 | 8 | `prev_trailer_offset` | u64 |  | Reserved for checkpoint trailers. MUST be 0 in 0.x. |
| 64 | 32 | `header_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of the 32 header bytes. |
| 96 | 32 | `index_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of the INDX payload. |
| 128 | 32 | `trailer_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of trailer bytes [0, 128). |

### `block_header` — 56 bytes

Frames every block. Blocks tile [HEADER_LEN, index_offset + BLOCK_HEADER_LEN + index_len).

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 4 | `type_id` | bytes4 |  | ASCII block type id. |
| 4 | 4 | `flags` | u32 | flags `block_flags` |  |
| 8 | 8 | `payload_len` | u64 |  | Bytes of payload following this header. |
| 16 | 32 | `payload_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of the payload bytes as stored. |
| 48 | 8 | `header_check` | bytes8 |  | First 8 bytes of BLAKE3 of this header's bytes [0, 48). Error detection, not trust. |

### `data_header` — 56 bytes

Start of every DATA payload; the stored bytes follow (payload_len - DATA_HEADER_LEN of them).

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `ino` | u64 |  | == ino of the inode whose extent references this block. |
| 8 | 8 | `file_offset` | u64 |  | == that extent's file_offset. |
| 16 | 4 | `raw_len` | u32 |  | == that extent's raw_len. |
| 20 | 2 | `codec` | u16 | enum `codec` |  |
| 22 | 2 | `reserved0` | u16 | MUST be 0 |  |
| 24 | 32 | `raw_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of the raw bytes. == that extent's raw_digest. |

### `index_header` — 136 bytes

Start of the INDX payload. Tables follow in `index_tables` order.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2 | `index_codec` | u16 | enum `index_codec` |  |
| 2 | 2 | `source_fs` | u16 | enum `source_fs` |  |
| 4 | 4 | `capabilities` | u32 | flags `capabilities` |  |
| 8 | 8 | `capture_time_sec` | i64 |  | Snapshot time, seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, signed. |
| 16 | 4 | `capture_time_nsec` | u32 |  | < NSEC_LIMIT. |
| 20 | 4 | `chain_count` | u32 |  |  |
| 24 | 16 | `source_fs_uuid` | bytes16 |  | Filesystem UUID of the captured source. |
| 40 | 8 | `root_ino` | u64 |  | ino of the root directory. Never assumed. |
| 48 | 4 | `base_ref` | u32 |  | 1-based chain entry this capture was taken relative to; 0 = full capture. |
| 52 | 4 | `reserved0` | u32 | MUST be 0 |  |
| 56 | 8 | `inode_count` | u64 |  |  |
| 64 | 8 | `dir_count` | u64 |  |  |
| 72 | 8 | `dirent_count` | u64 |  |  |
| 80 | 8 | `extent_count` | u64 |  |  |
| 88 | 8 | `xattr_count` | u64 |  |  |
| 96 | 8 | `tombstone_count` | u64 |  | MUST be 0 in 0.x. |
| 104 | 8 | `heap_len` | u64 |  |  |
| 112 | 8 | `writer_off` | u64 |  | Heap ref: writer name and version. Non-empty. |
| 120 | 4 | `writer_len` | u32 |  |  |
| 124 | 4 | `label_len` | u32 |  |  |
| 128 | 8 | `label_off` | u64 |  | Heap ref: free-text label. May be empty. |

Heap references: (`writer_off`, `writer_len`), (`label_off`, `label_len`).

### `chain_record` — 64 bytes

An ancestor archive this archive references.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 16 | `archive_uuid` | bytes16 |  |  |
| 16 | 32 | `index_digest` | bytes32 |  | The ancestor's trailer.index_digest. |
| 48 | 8 | `capture_time_sec` | i64 |  |  |
| 56 | 4 | `capture_time_nsec` | u32 |  |  |
| 60 | 4 | `reserved0` | u32 | MUST be 0 |  |

One inode alive in the snapshot. Sorted by ino, strictly ascending.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `ino` | u64 |  |  |
| 8 | 4 | `mode` | u32 |  | Linux st_mode: file_type (mask 0xF000) \| permission bits. |
| 12 | 4 | `generation` | u32 |  | Source i_generation. |
| 16 | 4 | `uid` | u32 |  |  |
| 20 | 4 | `gid` | u32 |  |  |
| 24 | 8 | `size` | u64 |  | reg: byte length. lnk: target length. Every other type: 0. |
| 32 | 8 | `atime_sec` | i64 |  |  |
| 40 | 8 | `mtime_sec` | i64 |  |  |
| 48 | 8 | `ctime_sec` | i64 |  |  |
| 56 | 8 | `crtime_sec` | i64 |  | 0 unless present.crtime. |
| 64 | 4 | `atime_nsec` | u32 |  |  |
| 68 | 4 | `mtime_nsec` | u32 |  |  |
| 72 | 4 | `ctime_nsec` | u32 |  |  |
| 76 | 4 | `crtime_nsec` | u32 |  |  |
| 80 | 4 | `rdev_major` | u32 |  | 0 unless chr/blk. |
| 84 | 4 | `rdev_minor` | u32 |  | 0 unless chr/blk. |
| 88 | 4 | `fs_flags` | u32 |  | Source-specific (see source_fs). 0 unless capabilities.fs_flags. |
| 92 | 4 | `present` | u32 | flags `present` |  |
| 96 | 2 | `content_kind` | u16 | enum `content_kind` |  |
| 98 | 2 | `reserved0` | u16 | MUST be 0 |  |
| 100 | 4 | `chain_ref` | u32 |  | 1-based chain entry if inherited, else 0. |
| 104 | 8 | `extent_first` | u64 |  | Tiling: index into the extent table. |
| 112 | 4 | `extent_count` | u32 |  | 0 unless content_kind = extents. |
| 116 | 4 | `xattr_count` | u32 |  |  |
| 120 | 8 | `xattr_first` | u64 |  | Tiling: index into the xattr table. |
| 128 | 8 | `target_off` | u64 |  | Heap offset of the symlink target; 0 unless symlink. |
| 136 | 32 | `content_digest` | bytes32 |  | BLAKE3 of the full logical content (holes as zeros) for extents/inherited; all-zero otherwise. |

One per directory inode, sorted by ino.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `ino` | u64 |  |  |
| 8 | 8 | `dirent_first` | u64 |  | Tiling: index into the dirent table. |
| 16 | 4 | `dirent_count` | u32 |  |  |
| 20 | 2 | `completeness` | u16 | enum `completeness` |  |

| 32 | 4 | `tombstone_count` | u32 |  | MUST be 0 in 0.x. |
| 36 | 4 | `reserved1` | u32 | MUST be 0 |  |

One name in a directory. Parent is implied by the dir_record whose range contains it.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `child_ino` | u64 |  |  |
| 8 | 8 | `name_off` | u64 |  |  |
| 16 | 4 | `name_len` | u32 |  |  |
| 20 | 4 | `reserved0` | u32 | MUST be 0 |  |

### `extent_record` — 56 bytes

One chunk of a file. Owner is implied by the inode_record whose range contains it.

| offset | size | field | type | constraint | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 8 | `file_offset` | u64 |  |  |

| 16 | 4 | `raw_len` | u32 |  | 1..=MAX_CHUNK_RAW. |
| 20 | 4 | `offset_in_block` | u32 |  | Reserved for PACK. MUST be 0. |
| 24 | 32 | `raw_digest` | bytes32 |  |  |

One extended attribute. Owner is implied by the inode_record whose range contains it.

| 0 | 8 | `name_off` | u64 |  | Full name including namespace, e.g. user.foo. |

| 16 | 4 | `name_len` | u32 |  |  |
| 20 | 4 | `value_len` | u32 |  |  |

## Index payload

After `index_header`, in this order:

| # | table | record | count field |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `chain` | `chain_record` | `index_header.chain_count` |
| 2 | `inode` | `inode_record` | `index_header.inode_count` |
| 3 | `dir` | `dir_record` | `index_header.dir_count` |
| 4 | `dirent` | `dirent_record` | `index_header.dirent_count` |
| 5 | `extent` | `extent_record` | `index_header.extent_count` |
| 6 | `xattr` | `xattr_record` | `index_header.xattr_count` |
| 7 | `tombstone` | *none defined; count MUST be 0* | `index_header.tombstone_count` |

Then the heap: `index_header.heap_len` bytes, following the last table. Heap offsets are from the first byte of the heap.

## Verification phases

A reader performs these in order and reports the first violated rule (see `rules.md`).

| # | phase | covers |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `envelope` | Size, header magic, version refusal, header flags. |
| 2 | `trailer` | Trailer magic, self digest, agreement with header, flags, header digest, reserved fields, classification, index geometry. |
| 3 | `index_seal` | INDX block header, its agreement with the trailer, and BLAKE3 of the payload. Nothing in the payload is parsed before this passes. |
| 4 | `index_structure` | Stage 1: index header enums/flags/reserved/ranges, table geometry, heap bounds, every record's enums/flags/reserved/ranges. |
| 5 | `index_semantics` | Stage 2, only on stage-1-valid data: order, tiling, per-type rules, namespace. |
| 6 | `blocks` | Archives only (not sidecars): block tiling, unknown types, DATA agreement with extents, digests, decoding, file content digests. |
| 7 | `chain` | Only when ancestors are supplied: agreement of inherited inodes with the ancestor that stores them. |

## Normative notes that are not rules

- Digests provide integrity, not authenticity. No key is involved; anyone able to write the archive can re-seal it. *(Not a rule: A statement about what the format does not claim; there is nothing a reader can check.)*
